WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1792432529027
    AND e.ts_ms < 1795110929027
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'signup_completed')
),
evb AS (SELECT actor, ts_ms, event, COALESCE(NULLIF(utm_source, ''), '(none)') AS bd, CASE WHEN event = '$pageview' AND 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m1, CASE WHEN event = 'signup_completed' AND 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m2, 0 AS noise FROM ev),
s1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT actor, ts_ms AS t1, bd AS bd1 FROM evb WHERE m1 = 1 AND ts_ms < 1795024529027),
s2 AS (
  SELECT p.actor, p.bd1, p.t1, MIN(e.ts_ms) AS t2
  FROM s1 p LEFT JOIN evb e ON e.actor = p.actor AND e.m2 = 1 AND e.ts_ms > p.t1 AND e.ts_ms <= p.t1 + 86400000
  GROUP BY p.actor, p.bd1, p.t1
),
r AS (SELECT actor, bd1, t1, t2, CASE WHEN t2 IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS reach FROM s2),
best AS (SELECT actor, MAX(reach) AS reach FROM r GROUP BY actor),
pick AS (SELECT r.actor, MIN(r.t1) AS t1 FROM r JOIN best b ON b.actor = r.actor AND b.reach = r.reach GROUP BY r.actor),
f0 AS (SELECT r.* FROM r JOIN pick k ON k.actor = r.actor AND k.t1 = r.t1),
f AS (SELECT f0.actor, f0.bd1 AS bd, f0.t1, f0.t2, f0.reach FROM f0)
SELECT f.bd AS bd, COUNT(*) AS n1, SUM(CASE WHEN f.t2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n2, SUM(CASE WHEN f.t2 IS NOT NULL THEN (f.t2 - f.t1) ELSE 0 END) AS dt2 FROM f GROUP BY f.bd

SELECT k, bd, (CASE WHEN dur > 0 THEN 1 WHEN dur < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS sign, CAST(floor(ln(abs((abs(dur) + (CASE WHEN dur = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)))) / 0.01980262729617973) AS INTEGER) AS key, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
  SELECT v.column1 AS k, f.bd AS bd, CASE v.column1 WHEN 2 THEN (f.t2 - f.t1) END AS dur FROM f CROSS JOIN (VALUES (2)) v
